subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical roadmap umbrella, or should its remaining metrics, session-handoff, and restart-preload contracts be split into separately owned issues?
rationale: The remaining work spans observability APIs, persisted session state, privacy boundaries, model cost, startup latency, defaults, and plugin-versus-core ownership; code inspection cannot safely choose those product contracts.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Keep or close the umbrella after creating or confirming narrow canonical issues for evaluation metrics, session continuity, and restart preload, each with explicit privacy and lifecycle acceptance criteria.

options.title: Sponsor one memory roadmap
options.body: Retain this issue as the canonical roadmap and have one owner define a staged, cross-surface design before implementation begins.

options.title: Rely on existing surfaces
options.body: Decline new core behavior and direct users to current memory plugins, explicit session tools, usage dashboards, and narrower open issues.

recommendation.title: Split by owner boundary
recommendation.body: Keep or close the umbrella after creating or confirming narrow canonical issues for evaluation metrics, session continuity, and restart preload, each with explicit privacy and lifecycle acceptance criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the broadest demonstrated history across the memory, usage, startup, and session surfaces and already reviewed the umbrella direction.
